optimizer.acceptance: Existing Q/wave/peak/PSD/ADC guards plus nonincrease of every supported conditional-wave cell and strict total Q-wave risk improvement.
optimizer.failed_trial: Restore parameters; if no trial passes also restore Adam state.

gradient_rule: Hard ADC/argmax/crop values remain bitwise exact. Add derivative of softmax over32 search codes at one-ADC-code temperature, times detached candidate windows. Existing selected-value derivative retained once.
endpoint_decision: Fresh two-bank32 primary PSD CDF improves >=10%, Q mass/wave/peak no worse by2%, flags do not increase. This is pilot advancement only, not original scientific acceptance.
authorization: 2026-10-21 user accepted the explained conditional waveform memory and one bounded direction check.

operation_budget.derivation: 103440 rows per two-bank8 pair:1 original normalization +2 gradient passes +1 ADC-gradient pass +5 probes +3 trials +12 endpoint pairs(original,inherited,new; two-bank32) =24*103440.

storage.archival_policy: Active compute checkpoint and endpoint scalars needed for immediate analysis; no NAS probes or duplicate large backups.

initialize_from: Frozen job158 B with10 cumulative accepted updates; new Adam moments and new conditional objective gradients.

joint_rule.secants: Single radius0.05 from existing local method; measured native probes. No radius sweep.
joint_rule.solver: Same linear program in convex hull of zero and at most5 native directions; append supported-cell nonincrease constraints.
joint_rule.constraints: Q_mass <=+0.5%, waveform <=0%, peak_codes <=+1%; PSD_CDF and each-bank continuous ADC margin risk nonincreasing.
joint_rule.ADC_margin: Mean per-row squared positive rail proximity in ADC codes; margin starts one code inside both physical rails, using actual pre-ADC min/max over384 samples.
joint_rule.validation: Hard evaluate combination at scales1,.5,.25; commit only if original guards, all flag counts, continuous rail risk, strict PSD improvement and strict total objective decrease pass.
joint_rule.optimizer: Reset Adam moments because objective changed; retain moments only if the single combined update commits.
joint_rule.limitation: Native secants are local approximations, not guarantees across peak jumps; hard evaluation is decisive.
joint_rule.ADC_directions: Exact gradient of continuous pre-ADC margin risk for each TRAIN bank separately, mapped through original diagonal lr-squared metric and normalized to wave-direction metric norm. Omit exactly-zero hinge gradients.
joint_rule.why: Saved population audit found opposing global wave contributions. This probe tests explicit local-Q waveform supervision and guards.

stop_rule: Exactly one direction attempt, at most5 native basis probes and3 combined hard trials; at most1 committed update. Stop regardless of result; no appended steps or sweep.

measured_budget_basis.basis: At most2.483M rows with one extra waveform backward and conditional moments; reestimate from actual launch progress.

conditional_wave_contract.features: Existing56 waveform features from raw256, amplitude-normalized256 and normalized first differences; standardized by fixed REAL FIT global feature mean and variance.
conditional_wave_contract.target: m_k = mean_REAL[a_k(Q) * standardized_wave_features]. Old16/32/64 soft-Q partitions and all18948 REAL FIT rows.
conditional_wave_contract.objective: Sum over levels and all cells of ||m_generated-m_REAL||^2/(3*56*max(REAL_mass,56/18948)); independent-bank cross product for training.
conditional_wave_contract.normalization: Append one block normalized once from original A0 under the original TRAIN normalization banks. Old target/weights prefix must remain bitwise identical.
conditional_wave_contract.cell_guard: Mean squared joint moment residual divided by max(REAL_mass,56/18948)^2; every supported cell nonincreasing within the fixed direction banks.
conditional_wave_contract.supported: Both REAL soft mass*18948 and effective sample count (sum weights)^2/sum(weights^2) >=56, the feature count. This is a declared engineering support rule, not a statistical confidence bound.
conditional_wave_contract.sparse: All cells and all rows remain in objective; mass denominator capped below at56/18948. Unsupported cells reported without individual hard constraints.
conditional_wave_contract.final_check: On independent two-bank32: unchanged original pilot gates; Q-wave strictly improves vs inherited B and every supported cell <=1.02 times inherited risk. At least one committed update required.
conditional_wave_contract.limitations: Joint distribution control in observed Q, not eventwise SOURCE-REAL pairing, source-population invariance, calibrated energy, temporal memory, or future-acquisition validation.
